mapper.select: select o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.listing_id as listingId, coalesce(l.title, concat('商品 #', o.listing_id)) as listingTitle, o.buyer_id as buyerId, o.seller_id as sellerId, case when o.buyer_id = #{userId} then seller.display_name else buyer.display_name end as counterpartyName, case when o.buyer_id = #{userId} then 'BUYER' else 'SELLER' end as role, o.source_type as sourceType, o.amount, o.status, o.offered_second_chance as offeredSecondChance, o.payment_deadline as paymentDeadline, o.ship_deadline as shipDeadline, o.gmt_create as createdAt, o.dispute_status as disputeStatus, o.reservation_status as reservationStatus, o.reservation_expires_at as reservationExpiresAt from order_record o join listing l on l.id = o.listing_id join app_user buyer on buyer.id = o.buyer_id join app_user seller on seller.id = o.seller_id where o.is_deleted = false and (o.buyer_id = #{userId} or o.seller_id = #{userId}) and o.buyer_id = #{userId} and o.seller_id = #{userId} and o.status = #{status} and o.id < #{cursor} order by o.id desc limit #{limit}

select b.id, b.auction_id as auctionId, a.listing_id as listingId, l.title as listingTitle, b.amount, b.deposit_required as depositRequired, b.status as bidStatus, a.status as auctionStatus, a.current_price as currentPrice, a.highest_bidder_id as highestBidderId, a.end_time as endsAt, b.gmt_create as createdAt from bid b join auction a on a.id = b.auction_id join listing l on l.id = a.listing_id where b.bidder_id = #{bidderId} and b.is_deleted = false and a.is_deleted = false and b.id < #{cursor} order by b.id desc limit #{limit}

select 'ORDER_PAYMENT' as type, o.id as resourceId, coalesce(l.title, concat('商品 #', o.listing_id)) as title, '订单正在等待你完成钱包付款' as description, concat('/orders/', o.id) as route, o.payment_deadline as dueAt from order_record o join listing l on l.id = o.listing_id where o.buyer_id = #{userId} and o.status in ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'SECOND_CHANCE') and o.is_deleted = false
union all
select 'SELLER_DECISION' as type, l.id as resourceId, l.title, '流拍后等待你决定重新拍卖、进入秒杀或退回库存' as description, concat('/workspace/listings/', l.id, '/unsold') as route, sc.decision_expires_at as dueAt from listing l join sale_channel sc on sc.listing_id = l.id where l.seller_id = #{userId} and l.status = 'WAITING_SELLER_DECISION' and sc.decision_status = 'WAITING' and l.is_deleted = false
union all
select 'SELLER_SHIPMENT' as type, o.id as resourceId, coalesce(l.title, concat('商品 #', o.listing_id)) as title, '买家已付款，请在截止时间前填写发货信息' as description, concat('/orders/', o.id) as route, o.ship_deadline as dueAt from order_record o join listing l on l.id = o.listing_id where o.seller_id = #{userId} and o.status = 'PAID' and o.is_deleted = false
union all
select 'LISTING_CHANGES' as type, l.id as resourceId, l.title, '审核要求补充或修改商品信息' as description, concat('/workspace/listings/', l.id) as route, l.gmt_modified as dueAt from listing l where l.seller_id = #{userId} and l.status = 'CHANGES_REQUIRED' and l.is_deleted = false
order by dueAt asc nulls last limit 80

select c.id, c.listing_id as listingId, l.title as listingTitle, case when c.buyer_id = #{userId} then c.seller_id else c.buyer_id end as otherPartyId, case when c.buyer_id = #{userId} then seller.display_name else buyer.display_name end as otherPartyName, c.status, c.last_sequence as lastSequence, case when c.buyer_id = #{userId} then c.last_sequence - c.buyer_last_read_sequence else c.last_sequence - c.seller_last_read_sequence end as unreadCount, coalesce(last_message.content, '还没有消息') as lastMessage, last_message.gmt_create as lastMessageAt from conversation c join listing l on l.id = c.listing_id join app_user buyer on buyer.id = c.buyer_id join app_user seller on seller.id = c.seller_id left join lateral ( select m.content, m.gmt_create from message m where m.conversation_id = c.id and m.is_deleted = false order by m.sequence_no desc limit 1 ) last_message on true where (c.buyer_id = #{userId} or c.seller_id = #{userId}) and c.is_deleted = false and c.id < #{cursor} order by c.id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: select o.id, o.id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.listing_id as listingId, coalesce(l.title, concat('商品 #', o.listing_id)) as listingTitle, o.buyer_id as buyerId, buyer.display_name as buyerName, o.seller_id as sellerId, seller.display_name as sellerName, o.amount, o.deposit_applied as depositApplied, o.escrow_amount as escrowAmount, o.status as orderStatus, o.dispute_status as disputeStatus, o.dispute_reason as reason, o.dispute_evidence as evidence, o.dispute_resolution as resolution, resolver.display_name as resolvedBy, o.paid_at as paidAt, o.shipped_at as shippedAt, o.received_at as receivedAt, o.dispute_opened_at as disputeOpenedAt, o.gmt_create as createdAt, o.dispute_resolved_at as resolvedAt from order_record o join listing l on l.id = o.listing_id join app_user buyer on buyer.id = o.buyer_id join app_user seller on seller.id = o.seller_id left join app_user resolver on resolver.id = o.dispute_resolved_by
mapper.select: where o.id = #{orderId} and o.dispute_status is not null and o.is_deleted = false and (#{privileged} = true or o.buyer_id = #{userId} or o.seller_id = #{userId})
